messages.message:
According to the (fictional) Northaven policy, you may return unused beakers in unopened original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a refund of the goods. You would pay return postage unless the items are faulty or sent in error. To start a return, email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and reason. You will receive a returns number and label within one working day.

Would you like help finding your order reference or any other support with your return?
